title: b7z9.25.4: Python+Rust: add stratum ordering gate to recovery acceptance
description: Spec R-02a-085: stratum ordering gates recovery acceptance. Neither Python nor Rust desync FSM checks stratum when accepting beacons in DESYNCED/RECOVERING states. RootCandidate has stratum field and it's used in root selection (multi_instance.rs:974), but not in desync recovery. Add stratum parameter to on_beacon() and reject beacons with worse stratum than stored best.
